translation.name: Makua New Testament 2015
translation.englishName: Makhuwa-Meetto: Makua New Testament 2015 New Testament

content: Nlhuku hoolhumacha wo iphiro yo Mwaamwanawe
Khalhayi vawo Nlhuku ahoolhumacha ni manyaapwiiya ihu venchi wo iphiro chinchi ni wo iphiro ya anamilhohi awe,

nansho alha mahuku ammalhelha alha honulhumacha ni hii wo iphiro yo Mwaamwanawe, nthanlhe awe wiira chittu chonkhaye chikhalhe chawawe. Ni wo iphiro yo yoyo Nlhuku ahoopa irimu ni ilhapo ni chittu chonkhaye chiriwo.

Mwaana phi waaria wo nthimicho wa Nlhuku, alhikaanaka ni Nlhuku mwanene, avarelhaka chittu chonkhaye wo nlhove nawe no machiri. Vamalhinhe awe unihapiha uwonya wihu, hokhalha vano wiirimu wiimonono wa Nlhuku o ikuru.
Paahi etu Mwaana phiri ni ipilhi yulhupalhe waapwaha minepa o wiirimu, thoko nchina vahiye awe ni Nlhuku chiri aya nulhupalhe upwaha machina aya.
Ukhalhawaya Nlhuku khaneera mena ata wo nnepa wo wiirimu mmoka uriyoothe wiira,

content.text: Lhelho, kinoolhumacha onkhaye achuwelhe wiira, Mii phi Athumwana.”

content: Ni vavawo etu Nlhuku vanonruma awe Mwaana awe o nttara velhaponi, neera,
Nansho wo minepa o wiirimu Nlhuku enre,

content.text: Ni akarumiya awe ukhalha malhimi o mooro.”
“Inyu Apwiiya Nlhuku, Ihiche inyu ye Imwene, phi yo mahuku o uhimalha.
Ikopo inyu phi naatawara attu inyu we ikekhiaye.
Inyuva nhottuna mitheko cho ikekhiaye, nhovenga iphiro cho uwonya.
Phi wo yoyo nlhatu uyo etu, Nlhuku, Nlhuku inyu,
ahoohikani makhura o ipilhi yuulhupalhe waapwaha akavihi ashikhunaninyu,
Ni irimu ni iyo phi ntheko wo miono chinyu.
Chonkhaye chiyo chinoovira, nansho inyu nnoolhokelha mahuku o uhimalha.
Nansho inyuva phi yalhe alhe mahuku o uhimalha,

content: Nlhuku khaamwirenlhe ata nnepa wo wiirimu awe mmoka wiira,

content.text: Mpaka vanohalha aka waathalha amalhaponi inyu wuuthi inyaa chinyu,

content: Chani minepa ayo phi apani? Yayo phi minepa anorumiya ni Nlhuku waakavihera alhe anohalha woopolhiya alhe.
